newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 10,000 tonnes of lentils for export, an official spokesman said on Thursday.
He told Reuters an international call for prices had been issued and January 7 was set as the final date to receive bids. Results would be announced on January 8.
The spokesman said partial offers of up to 1,000 tonnes could be accepted and the lentils would be ready for shipment in February.
